headline: Miss Brazil Marcella Kozinski Debuts Guarana Costume At Miss Universe
seoTitle: Miss Brazil Marcella Kozinski Miss Universe Costume
metaDescription: Marcella Kozinski showcased a costume inspired by guarana, featuring 40,000 crystals, following her return to Miss Universe 2026 events after an illness.
aiSummaryBullets: Marcella Kozinski presented a national costume themed around guarana at the Miss Universe 2026 pageant.
The attire, which incorporates recycled materials, was embellished with over 40,000 crystals.
The representative for Brazil resumed her contest duties after experiencing a brief health issue earlier in the week.
aiContextParagraph: The 75th edition of the Miss Universe pageant features 116 candidates competing for the title, with the final event approaching. Marcella Kozinski, the Brazilian contestant representing Paraná, is currently participating in the competition. Earlier in the week, Kozinski was temporarily sidelined from official pageant activities due to a reported illness. She has since recovered and rejoined the schedule of events. During the national costume presentation, which highlights the diverse cultural, floral, and faunal elements of the participating nations, Kozinski debuted an ensemble dedicated to guarana. The costume was noted for its intricate craftsmanship, featuring a detailed construction made from recycled materials and decorated with approximately 40,000 crystals. This year's pageant also includes several mothers among the contestants and features a new crown set with more than 3,000 diamonds.
whyItIsViral: The event is garnering attention due to the visual impact of the costume and public interest in the candidate's recovery, as covered by three independent media outlets.
